commitment.title: Doha Declaration of Principles — Government of the DRC and the AFC/M23
commitment.text: The Parties commit to an immediate and permanent ceasefire, to refrain from attacks against civilians and from hate propaganda, and to the restoration of State authority.

liveness: not terminated or superseded as of 2026-09-25 (Emil)

condition.dyad_note: UCDP codes the M23 as 'AFC' (the coalition M23 joined in Dec 2023); this is the only state-based dyad between the two parties in GED 26.1 (2024-07..2025-12) and Candidate 26.0.8, verified through the authenticated API on 2026-09-25.

baseline.data: GED 26.1 + Candidate 26.01.26.06 + 26.0.7 + 26.0.8, merged by event id, later release wins
baseline.filter: type_of_violence=1, dyad_new_id=17740, adm_1 in {Nord Kivu province, Sud Kivu province}, by date_start

a_mean_monthly_best_pre_commitment.note: January 2025 alone is 3,425 of 3,830; the mean is dominated by one month.

sentences: Counts, not causes. Attribution is UCDP's, not ours.

Each fatality counted here is a person whose life ended in violence that a signed commitment promised would stop; we count the events because dignity itself cannot be scored, and the count is not the goal — the absence of the events is.
